from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u081/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-bbe9cc6c.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0])
    colored_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)]
    if not colored_rows:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bottom = max(colored_rows)
    out = [[0 for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        shift = r - bottom
        for c, color in enumerate(row):
            if color:
                new_c = c + shift
                if 0 <= new_c < width:
                    out[r][new_c] = color
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
ns = {}
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), ns)
transform = ns['transform']
d1 = [[0]*11 for _ in range(10)]
for c in range(2,7): d1[2][c]=d1[6][c]=8
for r in range(3,6): d1[r][2]=d1[r][6]=8
e1 = [[0]*11 for _ in range(10)]
for r,cs in {2:[0,1,2],3:[3],4:[0,4],5:[1,5],6:[2,3,4,5,6]}.items():
    for c in cs:e1[r][c]=8

d2 = [[0]*11 for _ in range(10)]
for c in range(4,7):d2[3][c]=d2[7][c]=6
for r in range(4,7):d2[r][4]=d2[r][6]=6
e2 = [[0]*11 for _ in range(10)]
for r,cs in {3:[0,1,2],4:[1,3],5:[2,4],6:[3,5],7:[4,5,6]}.items():
    for c in cs:e2[r][c]=6
print(transform(d1)==e1, transform(d2)==e2)
test = [[0]*13 for _ in range(11)]
rows = {3:[6,7,8],4:[4,5,6,8],5:[4,8],6:[4,5,8],7:[5,8,9],8:[5,9],9:[5,6,7,8,9]}
for r,cs in rows.items():
    for c in cs:test[r][c]=7
answer = transform(test)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in answer))
